name: Backyard Ultra World Team Championship
notes: Even years. Every qualified country runs its own satellite race simultaneously, start Sat 17 Oct 2026 07:00 CDT; 74 national teams (~1,110 runners). No fixed finish: end date is a guess (2024 edition ran ~4-5 days at the leading satellites). Next team worlds Oct 2028 (out of range).

notes: Odd years, at Laz Lake's farm, Bell Buckle, Tennessee; top 50 national champions qualify. Start 16 Oct 2027 confirmed by organiser. End open-ended (2025 went ~a week), so end date is a guess. No individual edition in late 2026.

name: Barkley Marathons
notes: Date never announced; conch blown up to an hour before start. Usually mid-to-late March (sometimes early April) BUT 2026 started 14 Feb (Valentine's Day), earliest ever, so the window must now include mid-February. Race lasts up to 60h. One aggregator guesses 14 Feb 2027 (unverified). No official site.
